title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences for your account and the app.

personal.title: Personal details
personal.desc: How you appear in the app to your team.
personal.changeLoginHint: To change login methods, use <link>My account</link>.

company.title: Company
company.descOwner: Used in exported reports and documents.
company.descMember: Only the account administrator can edit these details.
company.industryHint: Set on first sign-in — controls which modules appear in the menu.

menuPosition.title: Menu position
menuPosition.desc: Navigation bar at the top or on the left side.

motion.title: Motion
motion.desc: Animates transitions and scroll effects. Reducing makes navigation more direct, independent of your system setting.

a11yWidget.title: Accessibility widget
a11yWidget.desc: Floating button in the bottom-right corner with text size, link underlining, reduced motion and Libras (Brazilian Sign Language). Applies to this device.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Interface language. Follows your account on any device.

chart.title: Default dashboard chart
chart.desc: Initial style of the "Revenue vs. Expenses" chart.

form.title: Found a problem or have an idea?
form.desc: Describe it in as much detail as you can. The team gets it right away and emails you back when it's resolved.
form.localImprovement: Where should it appear or change?
form.localPlaceholder: e.g. Dashboard → Cash flow card; Payables; login screen…
form.atualPlaceholderBug: What did you do and what went wrong? Steps, error message…
form.atualPlaceholderImprovement: How it works today (if it already exists).
form.esperadoPlaceholderImprovement: The idea: what should happen and why.
form.sentBug: Bug sent. Thanks for the report!

mine.title: My submissions
mine.emptyDesc: Your bugs and suggestions show up here with their status and the team's reply.

admin.deniedDesc: This tab is for the NexusFi team only.
admin.resolutionPlaceholder: What was done / the decision. Goes in the email to the user.

analytics.subtitle: Each "visitor" is a unique browser/device (identified by a cookie). Counts the whole app (signed in) and the public site.
analytics.loadError: Could not load the data right now. Try reloading in a moment.
analytics.deniedDesc: This tab is only visible to the platform administration.

chart.title: Unique visitors per day — last 30 days
chart.ariaLabel: Chart of unique visitors per day over the last 30 days
chart.footnote: Adding up the days doesn't give the month's total — someone returning on different days counts on each day. The month's number is in the card above.

pages.title: Most visited pages — last 30 days
pages.emptyDesc: As soon as someone visits the pages, the ranking shows up here.

loggedUsers.title: Logged in recently — last 7 days
loggedUsers.emptyTitle: No one logged in over the last 7 days
loggedUsers.emptyDesc: Accounts that log in show up here. Access from before this tab existed isn't included.

downloads.title: Windows app downloads
downloads.uniquePeopleHint: {clicks} clicks on the landing button · 1 per browser
downloads.hint: GitHub count: repeat downloads (and the app auto-update) count again.
downloads.emptyDesc: As soon as a GitHub release with the installer exists, downloads show up here.
downloads.loadError: Could not query GitHub right now. The other numbers are unaffected.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp alerts
whatsapp.desc: Get your company's important alerts on WhatsApp. Messages are sent from NexusFi's official number.
whatsapp.descMember: Only the account owner can change the number and alerts.
whatsapp.name: Your name (used in the greeting)
whatsapp.kindsTitle: Which alerts you want to receive

caixa.title: Cash register closing
caixa.desc: POS summary when a register is closed: sales by payment method and counting difference.

estoque.title: Low stock
estoque.desc: When a product reaches its minimum quantity or runs out.

contas.title: Bills payable
contas.desc: Taxes and bills due in 3 days, tomorrow and today, plus overdue notices (1 and 7 days). Every day at 8 am.

receber.title: Receivables
receber.desc: Customer invoices due in 3 days, tomorrow and today, and the ones that are overdue.

saldo.title: Cash alert
saldo.desc: When the projected balance turns negative in the coming days or drops below the minimum you set.

categorizar.title: Uncategorized entries
categorizar.desc: Every Monday, how many entries have no category. Improves your P&L and cash flow.

orcamento.title: Cost center budgets
orcamento.desc: When a cost center reaches 90% and when it exceeds the month's budget.

resumo.title: Financial summary
resumo.desc: Revenue, expenses, result and the 3 biggest expenses of the period.

whatsapp.consent: By saving, you authorize NexusFi to send these alerts to this number. Turn them off here at any time.
whatsapp.testSent: Test message sent. Check your WhatsApp.
whatsapp.notConfigured: The platform's WhatsApp sending isn't active yet. You can already save your preferences; alerts start as soon as it's turned on.
whatsapp.proTitle: WhatsApp alerts are a Pro plan feature
whatsapp.proBody: Get the register closing, low stock and bills due today on WhatsApp.
